findings.description: Admins cannot view or manage other users' profiles. Add a policy: CREATE POLICY user_profiles_admin_all ON public.user_profiles FOR ALL TO authenticated USING (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_roles WHERE user_id = auth.uid() AND role_id = 1));
Admins cannot assign roles or view role assignments for other users. Add policies for INSERT and SELECT allowing role_id = 1 (Admin).

supabase as any defeats type checking for profile insertion. Fix by removing the cast and using an explicit typed payload: const payload: Database['public']['Tables']['user_profiles']['Insert'] = { ... }
Concurrent or retried transactions can insert duplicate events. Add a unique partial index or application-level deduplication keys (idempotency_key column).

Unauthenticated users are redirected, but role checks happen only in Server Components via requireRole. Consider whether certain routes (e.g., /admin/*) should be blocked at the middleware level or if component-level checks are sufficient.
requireRole redirects to /unauthorized, but if that page doesn't exist, users see a 404. Create the page in Module K or document the requirement.

user_roles.granted_by comment says 'Admin who granted this role' but the column is nullable for system-granted roles. audit_log.user_id is nullable for system actions but doesn't document it. Clarify both comments.
